name: Guangzhou KDT Machinery Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangzhou KDT Machinery Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, and manufacturing of furniture machinery in China and internationally. It offers robotic saw tech, angular saw system, rear and front-loading panel saw, and reciprocating panel saw; router processing, labelling machine, and other nesting tech products; banding machines; drilling centers; and automated production lines. The company was formerly known as Guangzhou KDT Machinery Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Guangzhou KDT Machinery Group Co., Ltd. in August 2025. Guangzhou KDT Machinery Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
